items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject new production work, queue admission, requeues, spend, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, monetization expansion, external outreach, and unsupported financial or causal claims. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, period-aligned finance reconciliation, legal/security evidence, and parked-site readiness. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed and all unavailable cost, margin, ROI, forecast, and lift fields as unknown.

Keep queue admission closed while delivery is full. Complete one existing item with dated ownership, root cause or justified close, isolated validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence before any requeue or new queue selection.

Continue the existing 2026-09-21 period-aligned reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed; keep matching-period costs, commitments, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and cost-to-learn unknown. Do not extrapolate revenue or AI cost.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix. Preserve private launch gates and block public exposure and security-sensitive releases. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue existing parked-site readiness packets only. Preserve parked, private, preview-only status and document ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback, and explicit blocker evidence. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries.

Continue the existing consolidated read-only launch evidence bundle. Keep the gated product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not expand alerts, monetize, deploy, or alter configuration.
